striednig_type_i_filling_hyddown.title: Thermodynamic real gas analysis of a tank filling process

The YAML contains time and gas-mean-temperature measurements for 5, 10 and 30 MPa/min cases, but no measured pressure or mass-flow series and no station controller traces; it is not a full-loop validation set.

prhyde_d6_7_experimental_campaign.title: PRHYDE Results as Input for Standardisation
